settings.clearStorageDesc: This will permanently remove all settings and wallet data from this device.

settings.employerModeDesc: Batch payroll and freelance payouts. Data stays encrypted on this device.
settings.employerLabelDesc: Shown on signed receipts and to recipients verifying them.
settings.merchantModeDesc: Accept QR payments at a counter. Data stays encrypted on this device.
settings.merchantModeDisableDesc: Your merchant records stay safely encrypted on this device. The POS option will just be hidden until you turn Merchant Mode back on.
settings.merchantLabelDesc: Shown to customers on the payment request before they approve.
settings.merchantZeroConfThresholdDesc: Payments at or below this amount are accepted as soon as they're seen on the network, before being confirmed in a block — faster checkout, but with a brief window of double-spend risk. Keep this low for everyday counter sales.
settings.merchantRequiredConfirmationsDesc: How many blocks must confirm a payment above the instant-accept limit before it counts as paid. More confirmations are safer against a blockchain reorganization, but make the customer wait longer at checkout.
settings.dexModeDesc: Adds an optional BSC (EVM) account derived from this wallet's recovery phrase, for swapping on PancakeSwap. No network calls while turned off.
settings.tradeModeDesc: Peer-to-peer RFQ trading over Navio's own encrypted p2p bus — separate from DEX/EVM above. Requires a server carrying the trading bridge. Off by default — no network calls until enabled.
settings.chatModeDesc: End-to-end encrypted 1:1 messaging over navio-p2pmsg. Requires a node with p2pmsg user-messaging support (regtest/testnet builds for now). No connection while turned off.
settings.chatNicknameDesc: Shown to someone when you add them and send a contact request — before they've saved you as a contact, so your wallet name isn't a great label. Leave blank to use your wallet name.
settings.chatPeersDesc: Comma-separated peer addresses (host:port or ws://host:port) for a node running p2pmsg user messaging. Not deployed on mainnet yet — use a testnet/regtest node.
settings.faucetUrlDesc: Address of the navio-hl-faucet service that sends USDC + HYPE on Hyperliquid in exchange for NAV. The app is served over HTTPS, so an http:// address may be blocked by the browser.
settings.chatNetworkDesc: Must match the chain the peer above actually runs — it picks the P2P magic bytes. A mismatch connects but the node drops the link on the first message. Only change this when testing against a local regtest/testnet relay that differs from your wallet's own network.
settings.slippageDesc: How much the price can move against you before a swap reverts. Higher tolerance means swaps succeed more often but you may get a worse price.
settings.txDeadlineDesc: How long a swap can stay pending before it's rejected by the router.
settings.unlockDurationDesc: Remembers the password of an encrypted wallet on this device, counted from the last time you typed it. During that time anyone with access to this device can open the wallet.
settings.autoOpenLastWalletDesc: Skip the wallet list on startup and open the wallet you used last.

agreement.description: This Agreement governs your use of Navio Go Wallet. By continuing, you confirm that you understand and accept the terms outlined below.

agreement.responsibility: You are solely responsible for safeguarding your wallet, recovery phrase, device security, and all activities performed using the application. Loss of access credentials may result in permanent and irreversible loss of digital assets.

agreement.blockchain: All transactions are executed directly on blockchain networks. Once confirmed, transactions are irreversible. Network fees, delays, or failures are determined by the blockchain and are outside of Navio's control.
agreement.liability: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Navio Go Wallet shall not be liable for any loss of funds, data, profits, or damages arising from the use or inability to use the application, including but not limited to user error, device compromise, or third-party failures.
